fact: Redux Maker v1 routes kill-effect proposals to timecycle_mods_4.xml (timecycle 4), not animpostfx.ymt.
Sky and weather proposals may target known-safe scalar fields in visualsettings.dat and timecycle/weather XML while preserving unknown fields and structure.
Hit Effect is the user-facing label; ptfx_blood_spray is the primary technical target unless live inspection proves it missing.
Smoke, fire, and resource-heavy particle visuals must be blanked with same-dimension and same-format replacement data; entries must not be deleted.
minimap.gfx editing uses JPEXS as an external SWF XML roundtrip tool; direct swf.xml editing remains available when JPEXS is absent.
